highlights.title: Alibaba Unveils Third Closed-Source AI Model in Focus on Profit
highlights.description: Alibaba Group Holding Ltd. has released its third proprietary AI model in as many days, reinforcing the company’s intent to focus on profiting off its flagship artificial intelligence services.

highlights.title: Google's $20 per month AI Pro plan just got a big storage boost
highlights.description: Google's $20 per month AI Pro plan, which includes Gemini, Veo and Nano Banana, got a big storage boost and some other new perks. Users of the plan (also available for $200 per year) will see their cloud space jump from 2TB to 5TB at no extra cost. That extra storage can be used not only for AI but also Gmail, Google Drive and Google Photos backups. Gemini can now pull context from Gmail and the web for Drive, Docs, Slides and Sheets, provide summaries for your Gmail inbox and proofread emails b

highlights.title: Huawei's cloud computing revenue dropped in 2025 as Chinese AI lagged U.S. rivals
highlights.description: When including internal customers, the telecommunications giant said cloud computing revenue grew from a year ago.

highlights.title: Ripple Treasury puts XRP and RLUSD inside corporate finance for the first time
highlights.description: The treasury management system, built on Ripple's 2025 acquisition of GTreasury, lets CFOs view and manage digital assets alongside fiat in a single dashboard without separate custody or wallet infrastructure.
